name: Call-to-action band
summary: Full-width band with one sentence, one line of support, and one action. Accent or quiet surface tone.
accessibility: On the accent tone the action swaps colors: accent-ink background with accent text. Check that pair's contrast for your style.
The action is a link with a visible focus outline.

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: A 2px outline in the focus color.

states.name: surface tone
states.description: Surface background with ruled edges instead of the accent fill.
